description: This PHP file defines the Vtiger_Version class, providing utility methods for retrieving and comparing the Vtiger CRM version, including methods for version comparison, checking suffixes, and handling version ranges.

classes.name: Vtiger_Version
classes.description: A utility class for handling Vtiger CRM version information and comparisons.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current Vtiger version in use.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Compares the current Vtiger version with a specified version based on a condition.

methods.name: endsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a specified substring.

methods.name: getUpperLimitVersion
methods.description: Returns the upper limit version when a version pattern with wildcard (e.g., '5.4.*') is given.
